newsitem.title: USA: Motorola gets $132 mln Brazil contract.
newsitem.headline: Motorola gets $132 mln Brazil contract.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Cellular Infrastructure Group said Tuesday it won a $132 million contract to expand a cellular telephone network in Brazil.

The company said Telecomunicacoes de Parana SA (TELEPAR) will use Motorola's Advanced Mobile Phone Service (AMPS) network to expand coverage into its southern region. Commercial service is scheduled to begin in January of 1998.
Motorola said distribution and installation of the equipment will be handled by Motorola do Brasil, Motorola's local unit.
TELEPAR's southern region will have a system capacity of 100,000 subscribers, Motorola said. The region covers 58 cities.
TELEPAR is the fourth largest telecommunications company in the TELEBRAS (Telecomunicacoes do Brasil SA) system.
